name: Iron Longsword
title: Starter Blade
description: A well-balanced standard forge blade. Delivers crisp directional slashes on push-up lockout.

name: Twin Viper Daggers
title: High Cadence Blades
description: Ultra-light serrated twin blades. Fires rapid dual slashes with elevated 35% critical rate.

requirement.description: Complete 5 push-ups in your workout session.

name: Executioner Cleaver
title: Form Streak Heavy Blade
description: Massive two-handed greatsword. Deals a 220° wide cleave through all clustered foes with heavy 0.08s hitstop crunch.

requirement.description: Achieve a continuous 10-rep push-up streak without breaking form.

name: Stormcaller Warhammer
title: High Intensity Relic
description: Infused with atmospheric lightning. On validated rep, calls down cascading chain lightning arcs between all enemies.

requirement.description: Maintain a fierce intensity pace of 25+ reps per minute for at least 3 reps.

name: Bulwark Shield & Spear
title: Endurance Master
description: Tower shield paired with a thrusting spear. Bottom plank holds build barrier energy; lockout unleashes an armor-piercing thrust.

name: Dimensional Void Katana
title: Precision Masterpiece
description: Forged at the boundary of reality. Deep <= 80° elbow push-ups slice through spacetime, instantly cutting all targets in line.

requirement.description: Perform 6 flawless 'PERFECT' form push-ups (deep >= 90° angle, controlled tempo).
